messages:
marta: quick holiday ping  who wants to join a tiny 'desk snowflake decor' swap? make one, leave it on the community table, take one you like. plus a secret snack stash label if you're down. :snowflake: :cookie:

owen: love this. count me in. can we also do a tiny note with each flake? like 'take me for a smile'.

li: i'll craft one tonight. low effort question: what's the deadline to drop it off?

marta: drop-off Fri noon? i'll pin a sticky on the community board too.

sophia: can remote folks join with mailed flakes? i'm remote in london. also vote for tiny snack stash (i will guard it). :british_flag:

mike: mini rules suggestion: 1) handmade or upcycled only 2) one flake per person 3) optional secret snack slip inside (no perishable >24h). sound OK?

marta: yes to all. remote folks DM me your address and i'll pair you with someone who can mail.

owen: what about allergic folks? maybe a 'no-nut' sticker on snack slips.

li: good call. i'll add a template sticker: NO_NUTS.

sophia: sending a tiny paper template in a sec. also, can we have a 'mystery backstory' line on each flake? like 1 sentence about why you made it. cute prompts: 'my favourite holiday smell' or 'a tiny good thing from my week.'

mike: love the backstory idea. will write a 1-line haiku.

marta: ops-bot: please add an all-hands reminder? (kidding, but i'll post on calendar) :grin:

thread-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Desk Snowflake Swap drop-off" Fri 12:00 (channel: #random).

li: small craft tip: fold paper twice then cut symmetrical shapes, use small hole punch + baker's twine to hang. recycled gift-wrap works great.

sophia: submitting a remote entry: tiny origami snowflake + recipe for lemon tea bag (non-perishable).

owen: i'll hide a tiny sticker that says 'you rock' in one of the flakes for whoever finds it.

marta: love the energy. final notes: drop-off Fri by noon, label snacks 'NO_NUTS' if applicable, small backstory on 1-line slip. i'll post a sign-up list (name + in-office/remote) in 5. thanks y'all :sparkles:
